raw_plan.root_cause: The function copies an input string into a 16-byte stack buffer without checking the length, allowing overflow.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Copies the input string into a local buffer and then prints the buffer using puts.
raw_plan.required_invariant: The copied string must fit within the 16-byte buffer, including the null terminator, and the stack canary must remain intact.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Before copying, check the length of the input string. If the length is greater than 15, skip the copy and print an empty string or handle gracefully. Otherwise, proceed with the copy.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: If the input is too long, the function should not copy and should print an empty string (or a safe default) to avoid overflow.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For valid inputs (length <= 15), the function copies and prints as before. For invalid inputs, it prints an empty string and returns normally.
verification_conditions: Input length <= 15: output matches original behavior.
Input length > 15: no overflow occurs, stack canary intact, function returns normally.
Only calls to helper_copy and puts are made.

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
